      @Deprecated public SourceRecord(String sourceGroup, PitzerBinaryVolumetricDatasetProvenance.DatasetRole role, String citation, String sourceUrl, String licenseId, String licenseUrl, PitzerBinaryVolumetricDatasetProvenance.RedistributionStatus redistributionStatus, String sha256, String uncertaintyBasis, int observationCount, double minimumMolality, double maximumMolality, double minimumTemperatureK, double maximumTemperatureK, double minimumPressurePa, double maximumPressurePa)

    • SourceRecord

      public SourceRecord(String sourceGroup, PitzerBinaryVolumetricDatasetProvenance.DatasetRole role, String citation, String sourceUrl, String licenseId, String licenseUrl, PitzerBinaryVolumetricDatasetProvenance.RedistributionStatus redistributionStatus, String sha256, String uncertaintyBasis, PitzerBinaryVolumetricDatasetProvenance.UncertaintyQualification uncertaintyQualification, int observationCount, double minimumMolality, double maximumMolality, double minimumTemperatureK, double maximumTemperatureK, double minimumPressurePa, double maximumPressurePa)
      Construct a source-lineage record.
      Parameters:
      sourceGroup - non-empty laboratory or source-lineage identifier
      role - calibration or validation role
      citation - full citation or DOI description
      sourceUrl - stable source URL
      licenseId - license identifier, or an explicit unknown/restricted marker
      licenseUrl - license URL; mandatory when redistribution is permitted
      redistributionStatus - audited redistribution decision
      sha256 - lowercase or uppercase SHA-256 of the distributed source file
      uncertaintyBasis - description of the absolute one-sigma uncertainty mapping
      uncertaintyQualification - audited suitability of that mapping for weighted repository use
      observationCount - exact number of represented observations
      minimumMolality - minimum formula-unit molality in mol/kg solvent
      maximumMolality - maximum formula-unit molality in mol/kg solvent
      minimumTemperatureK - minimum temperature in K
      maximumTemperatureK - maximum temperature in K
      minimumPressurePa - minimum absolute pressure in Pa
      maximumPressurePa - maximum absolute pressure in Pa
